method: Actual rendered suit CPU skinning + visible PLSS/helmet/overshoes, triangle BVH against full R2 meshes including hidden cutaway walls and original descent geometry; Sampling intervals recorded in this report. Triangle intersections prove a conflict; absence is not continuous collision certification.
